status.main_product: empty hard gelatin and cellulose-based capsule shells
status.scope_reason: The company is a major manufacturer and global supplier of empty gelatin and HPMC/cellulose-based capsules for the pharmaceutical and dietary supplement industries.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs data via ZaubaCorp and Tofler registry updates from 2026, ACG Associated Capsules Private Limited remains active and manufactures empty hard capsules from its headquarters in Mumbai, India.

claims.claim: The company's hard gelatin capsule standard specifications document shows tight dimensional tolerances, including a length tolerance of ±0.40 mm, a closed joined length tolerance of ±0.40 mm, and a nominal cap and body outside diameter tolerance of ±0.03 mm.
claims.note: The specific dimensions of a length tolerance of ±0.40 mm, a closed joined length tolerance of ±0.40 mm, and a nominal cap and body outside diameter tolerance of ±0.03 mm are unconfirmed in official company documentation.

claims.claim: The company reports the development of the ACGcaps™ HX product line, which is an HPMC-based, animal-free delayed-release capsule engineered with a special polymer that protects acid-sensitive ingredients from gastric fluids and guarantees a disintegration time of at least 30 minutes based on in-house testing protocols.
claims.source: ACG World Website (ACGcaps HX product documentation)

claims.claim: The company reports the development of ACGcaps™ HA, an immediate-release HPMC capsule engineered with an optimized amount of gelling agent designed to leverage a differentiated solubility profile and meet strict dissolution requirements in 0.01N HCl at a pH of 2.0.
claims.source: ACG World Website (ACGcaps HA product documentation)

claims.claim: The company reports a total consolidated annual capacity of approximately 170 billion capsules as of 2026, driven by its main manufacturing footprint across multiple locations including India, Europe, Brazil, and Thailand, according to CARE Ratings.
claims.corrected: The company reports a total consolidated annual capacity of approximately 170 billion capsules as of 2026, driven by its main manufacturing footprint across five state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India, according to CARE Ratings.

claims.claim: The company commenced operations at a new 175,000-square-meter capsule production facility in Rayong, Thailand in December 2024, designed to produce 20 billion hard gelatin capsules annually, according to Fierce Pharma.

The company reports that its Pithampur capsule manufacturing facility holds an EXCiPACT Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certification issued by the certification body SGS, which covers the manufacture of empty hydroxyl propyl methyl cellulose capsule shells and hard gelatin capsule shells.
claims.source: EXCiPACT Certificate Holder Records (SGS Certification for Pithampur Site)

claims.claim: The company reports that its HPMC capsule brand, ACGcaps H+, became the world’s first capsule to receive a compliance certification from the US-based non-profit Clean Label Project after passing a comprehensive screening against Proposition 65 and over 400 industrial and environmental contaminants.
claims.source: Clean Label Project Certification Documentation for ACGcaps H+

claims.claim: The credit rating firm CRISIL reports that the group’s diversified customer portfolio consists of marque clients such as Cadila Healthcare Ltd, Aurobindo Pharma Ltd, Alkem Laboratories Ltd, and Sanofi S.A. (CRISIL Rating Rationale)
claims.source: CRISIL Ratings Rationale for ACG Associated Capsules Private Limited

claims.claim: The company reports in its official regulatory documentation that it services about 350 regular customers globally, which include the biggest multi-nationals, and caters to over 80% of Asia's pharmaceutical prescription market. (ACG Capsules USA LOA Documentation)
claims.source: ACG Associated Capsules Official Regulatory Documentation (USA LOA)

claims.claim: The parent entity, ACG Group, reported achieving strong financial results with consolidated revenues of ₹53,142 million for the financial year 2024–25.

On a standalone basis, the specific subsidiary ACG Associated Capsules Private Limited generated an operating revenue exceeding ₹1,000 crore (INR 10 billion) for the financial year ending on March 31, 2025, representing an 11.44% net sales revenue increase over the previous fiscal period.
claims.source: EMIS Company Profile (July 2026), Tracxn, and The Company Check reports confirm that ACG Associated Capsules Private Limited's FY 2025 revenue exceeded ₹1,000 crore (reaching ₹3,600.7 Cr), with an 11.44% net sales revenue increase over the previous period.

claims.claim: The company reports that as of June 2024, its capsule shell manufacturing facilities are distributed across seven specific global locations: Dahanu, Kandivli, Shirwal, Pithampur, and Aurangabad in India, alongside dedicated regional sites in Croatia, Brazil, and Thailand, delivering a collective annual capacity of 189 billion hard gelatin and cellulose capsule shells.
claims.source: ACG Capsules FAQ Management documentation confirms the listed global locations (Dahanu, Kandivli, Shirwal, Pithampur, Aurangabad, Croatia, Brazil, Thailand) and a collective capacity of 189 billion per annum (163.4 billion hard gelatin and 25.6 billion cellulose capsule shells).

claims.claim: Fierce Pharma reported in October 2025 that the company announced an expansion of its global footprint via a $200 million investment to build its first empty-capsule production plant in the United States, based in Georgia.
claims.corrected: The company announced an expansion of its global footprint via a $200 million investment to build its first empty-capsule production plant in the United States, based in Georgia.
claims.source: ACG official media release (2024/2025) and news reports confirm the announcement of the $200 million plant in Georgia, US, but it was announced directly by the company (not 'Fierce Pharma reported in October 2025' as the main context; the event occurred earlier and was self-reported).

claims.claim: The company reports a total annual production capacity exceeding 150 billion empty hard-shell capsules globally in its independent assurance sustainability report for FY 2025-26.
claims.note: The total annual production capacity is stated globally as 140 billion capsules by the company site, and the specific mention of '150 billion empty hard-shell capsules' inside an 'independent assurance sustainability report for FY 2025-26' could not be verified.

claims.claim: The company reports an installed base of 33,237 machines globally across its full solid dosage engineering portfolio, alongside more than 2,227 specific installations of its AF (automatic filling) capsule series worldwide.
claims.source: ACG World corporate site ('ACG in numbers' section) confirms 33,237 installed machines for customers worldwide, and the AF Series product catalog confirms 'With 2,227 successful installations (and counting) across the world...'

claims.claim: The company reports a strategic partnership with Art of You (AoY) announced in May 2025 to develop and launch the Personalized Capsule Machine (PCM), combining ACG Associated Capsules Pvt. Ltd.'s capsule and beadlet technologies with AoY's custom supplement formulations.
The company announced a partnership with Allied Pharma in May 2026 to co-present automated cartoning and packaging systems, specifically the Blister X and Karton X machines, at Interpack 2026.

The company reports a total consolidated annual capacity of approximately 170 billion capsules as of 2026, driven by its main manufacturing footprint across five state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India, according to primary research.
claims.source: ACG Group Sustainability Report 2025-26 & CARE Ratings Report (Scribd)
